execution_scope.authorization_reference: Direct latest user instruction and frozen control/user-authorization.json

resources.budget_basis: Root-owned one RTX5080, two concurrent private process groups; worker CPU2/RSS4GiB/allocator3GiB; pool owned GPU<=8GiB and hostRSS<=12GiB; no shared environment change
resources.start_gate: Actual root launch pool rechecks GPU process/usage, CPU affinity/RSS and immutable inputs before each new unit; WSL external-process visibility limitations preserved

environment.lockfile_kind: Observed installed runtime snapshot, plus SHA-bound reused vendor dependency manifests in launch proof; no package install or lockfile synthesis

numerical_policy.input_dtype: float32 graph features/int64 tokens and edge indices
numerical_policy.determinism: Actual runtime deterministic_algorithms=true,warn_only=true; architecture-specific nondeterministic warnings retained; seeds0–9, no bit-exact CUDA claim
numerical_policy.notes: Snapshot inspected exact generic WSL interpreter and reused vendor modules; formal runner binds the same source and applies policy before model creation.

process_control.mechanism: Root launch/pool_supervisor.py creates private PGID/session, checks owned PID identity/RSS/GPU reservations and bounds descendants to original deadline; run_unit.py children inherit PGID

execution.post_issue_binding_policy: Fixed command executes run_bound_unit.py --binding <unit JSON>. Root creates and SHA-binds that JSON in a separate post-issue launch index after actual contract and execution-validation byte hashes exist. No own SHA is embedded in this contract. Resolved argv and clipped unit deadline retained by binding receipt.
